The following events took place in approximately '''11,920 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*The [[Fourth Pius Dea Crusade]] occurs. The [[Pius Dea]]-controlled [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] launches yet another military invasion of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]], attacking [[Planet/Legends|planets]] in the northern part of the region such as [[Klatooine/Legends|Klatooine]], [[Sy Myrth/Legends|Sy Myrth]], [[Boonta/Legends|Boonta]], and the [[Junkfort system|Kossimur system]].<ref name="EGW" />
